## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2026-04-27: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.6 to the S-1/A
- 2026-05-07: TRA executed at IPO close
- 2026-05-08: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the IPO-closing 8-K

## Explanation

Suja Life, Inc. executed this TRA on May 7, 2026 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from a bundle of tax attributes inherited and to be generated by the IPO structure: pre-IPO Blocker Attributes carried over from PSP Suja Life Blocker and Vive Aggregator, basis acquired through the IPO Exchange, and Section 754 step-ups arising from future Exchanges of Holdings LP Units for Class A common stock. Suja Life Holdings, L.P. and its tax-partnership subsidiaries are required to keep a Section 754 election in effect for any taxable year that includes an Exchange. The TRA is brand new and in force; no periodic reports, amendments, or payment events exist yet as of the data cutoff one week after the IPO close. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
